english.title: Cause / permit discharge of deleterious matter at Manchester Airport likely to obstruct drains / sewers etc
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without lawful authority or the permission of the Airport Company first having been obtained, caused or permitted the discharge at Manchester Airport of

(A)_[hydrocarbon]_
(B)_[deleterious matter, namely **(..SPECIFY MATTER..),]_
(C)_[a substance, namely **(..SPECIFY SUBSTANCE..),]_

which might have

(D)_[obstructed]_
(E)_[been a source of damage to]_
(F)_[become a source of damage to]_

a drain, sewer or other area of infrastructure and which would or may have constituted a risk to the environment, public health or health or wellbeing of animals
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 2.2 and 4.9 of the Manchester Airport PLC Byelaws 2024.
